faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How long does a project take?
faq.a1: It depends on scope — small sites 2–4 weeks, large platforms 2–3 months. We give an exact timeline during discovery.
faq.a2: Every project is different. We listen to your needs and prepare a transparent quote — no hidden costs.
faq.a3: Yes. We stay with you after launch — offering support and growth packages.
faq.q4: Can you revamp my existing site?
faq.a4: Absolutely. We audit your current product and propose a redesign or step-by-step improvement.
